## Demo scenarios (generated)

Search: every curated site, baseline landings daily from 2027-01-01 to the end of the ephemeris, slips of 1-30 days later. Mission 14 days, observer 2 m, Sun threshold 0.5, Earth margin 1.0° (app defaults). Ranking score is **Both** (Sun and Earth link). The search uses hourly samples; the numbers below are the 1-minute reference (`golden.py`) and agree with the TS engine to the parity tolerances in SPEC.md (checked against `golden.json`).

### Rank flips: the best site changes after a slip

A flip needs the winner to lead by at least 10 points before the slip and trail by at least that much after it. Flips come from distinct places (sites within 40 km count as one) where enough exist.

**1. IM-2 Athena (Mons Mouton) vs Shackleton–de Gerlache connecting ridge**: slip 15 days, landing 2029-02-20 → 2029-03-07. Gap in Both %: +51.2 → -61.7 (swing 112.9 points).

| | Site | Landing (UTC 00:00) | Sunlit | Earth link | Both | First sunset |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | IM-2 Athena (Mons Mouton) (`mons-mouton-im2`) | 2029-02-20 | 77.2% | 55.4% | **51.2%** | 273.4 h |
| baseline | Shackleton–de Gerlache connecting ridge (`connecting-ridge`) | 2029-02-20 | 7.5% | 24.8% | **0.0%** | 183.9 h |
| slip +15 d | IM-2 Athena (Mons Mouton) (`mons-mouton-im2`) | 2029-03-07 | 0.0% | 100.0% | **0.0%** | no sunlight |
| slip +15 d | Shackleton–de Gerlache connecting ridge (`connecting-ridge`) | 2029-03-07 | 61.7% | 79.5% | **61.7%** | 329.9 h |

Reproduce: sites `mons-mouton-im2` + `connecting-ridge`, duration 14 d, landing 2029-02-20T00:00:00Z, slip slider +15 d.

## The 30-second demo (UI v2 console, hand-written; outside the generated block)

The app opens on the first scenario above ("Athena vs ridge", 20 Feb 2029) in the 3D Terrain view. Add `?nointro` to the URL to skip the fly-in when rehearsing.

| s | Screen | What to do and say |
|---|---|---|
| 0–4 | Intro fly-in | The Moon orbits down to the south pole while the boot log counts the real data (ephemeris epochs, sites, grid). "The Sun skims the horizon at the pole, so mountains cast shadows hundreds of kilometres long." Esc or Skip ends it early. |
| 4–10 | 3D Terrain | Real shadows from the LOLA terrain and the SPICE ephemeris; beacons A and B say in words what each site has (`SUN + EARTH`, `EARTH ONLY`, …). The deck shows Athena at Sun 77 % / Earth 55 % / Both 51 %. |
| 10–18 | Deck: **Try +15 d** | Shadows sweep. Athena drops to Sun 0 % (−77 points); the ridge site rises from 7 % to 62 % (+54). "Fifteen days of slip hands the lead to the ridge." |
| 18–24 | **Surface**, Play | From the lander: the Sun slides along the skyline and the ridge blocks it (`SUN BLOCKED · ridge at az …`) in the same frame the timeline says blocked. |
| 24–30 | **Verify** | "Checked against JPL Horizons: max error 0.000026° elevation; 10 of 12 sites within ±5 points of NASA's PGDA." Every number on this tab is read from `validation.json`. |

Also worth showing if there is time: the PGDA and window-score overlays on 3D Terrain (the "2D map" button gives exact hover values), **Details** (full metric table and timeline), and `[` / `]` to fold the rail and hide the deck for a clean stage.

The intro is skipped by `?nointro`, Esc, the Skip button, reduced-motion settings, no WebGL and synthetic fixture data. It lasts 4.0 s and the console loads underneath it, so the horizon grid is already coming in.

Screenshots: [3D live shadows](img/ui-v2/terrain-1440-live-shadows.jpg), [3D PGDA Sun](img/ui-v2/terrain-1440-pgda-sun.jpg), [Surface](img/ui-v2/surface-1440.jpg), [2D map, Window Sun](img/ui-v2/map-1440-window-sun.jpg) (from the earlier Slice 1 console).

Measured in Chrome on the production build (Apple Silicon, 3 sites × 30 d, 3D Terrain + deck + slip outlook mounted, 39 slider steps): each step reaches the screen in a median 15 ms (p95 17 ms, max 18 ms; synchronous commit median 7.6 ms), no long tasks, so the 33 ms slip budget holds. Transfer sizes on the Vercel preview (brotli, Slice 1): `grid-horizons.bin` 11.9 MB → 4.75 MB, `terrain-display.bin` 2.1 MB → 1.78 MB, both streamed after first paint. The intro texture (`textures/moon-color-2k.jpg`, 447 kB) loads after first paint with the intro chunk; main JS is 89.7 kB gzip.
